German Gen Z Protests Turn Violent with Looting and Clashes

Protests by Germany's Gen Z turned violent in Frankfurt, with thousands taking to the streets. Reports indicate looting of shops and attacks on police, with some instances involving Molotov cocktails. Images from the event show fires burning in the streets and individuals confronting authorities.
